items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet ruled out after non-contact knee injury in TNF win over Patriots; coach Ben Johnson said it did not look good, more tests today. Appears lost for significant time.
items.why: Non-contact knee late in TNF; carted off, thumbs up but ruled out immediately.
items.implication: Immediate TE upgrade path in Bears offense for remaining options.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for Colston Loveland and any other TEs.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited. Rapoport notes it is believed to be minor.
items.why: Exited practice with calf; limited on report.
items.implication: Game-time decision risk for Week 7 vs LV; monitors Friday practice closely.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, elevated targets/routes for remaining WRs/TEs post-Adams IR.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially DNP second straight day due to hamstring.
items.implication: High OUT risk Week 7; monitor Friday.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS value volatility depending on landing spot/Colts intent.
items.opportunity: Feature role likely anywhere; monitor deadline.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical treatments and non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers; OL mess contributes. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access signals impending return eligibility; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs RB1 upside ROS once cleared; fade or handcuff Lloyd/Johnson short-term.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down work reverts to Jacobs; poor EPA for backups opens door.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is in line to play vs Dallas MNF (Berry RB15). Efficient in two full games played; Dallas top fantasy RB matchup.
items.why: Hamstring limited but expected active; efficient prior.
items.opportunity: Feature back carries/red-zone vs soft DAL.

items.text: Giants plan to start JJ McCarthy vs Houston. Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: McCarthy 5.7 vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9. Different scheme/coaches/small sample but hard to ignore.
items.why: Low YPT sample with McCarthy raises efficiency concern.
items.implication: Jefferson WR1 but muted ceiling/floor risk with new QB.
items.opportunity: Target volume may hold but YAC/efficiency drop possible.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson not expected ready off IR soon per Schefter source. Notable as he was biggest Adams injury beneficiary; Rams answer now 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson recovery delayed; Adams IR opens massive target share.
items.implication: Puka elite WR1 ceiling ROS with Adams out 6-10 weeks.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Bears good for yardage; Brown back in real role with high target share/routes despite recent drops.
items.why: Matchup + usage rebound; 33% target share, 97% routes recently.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets vs soft Bears secondary.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Elite volume expected; Eagles offense setup favorable.
Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6). Lions defense gift to opposing pass catchers all season.
Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12). Big workloads in friendly matchups; defenses carved up by RBs.
Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Josh Jacobs @ DET, Cam Skattebo @ HOU. Nasty matchups, role/workload questions, low-scoring offenses.
items.why: Matchup/role issues; Jacobs post-layoff workload Q.
items.conflict: Levitan more constructive on Jacobs return.

items.text: Week 7 Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB@CAR, GB@DET, LAR@LV. Slow slogs MIA@NYJ, SF@ATL, IND@MIN. High-volume notes on GB/DET etc for fantasy friendliness.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE/snaps data favor high-volume games.
items.implication: Prioritize players in up-tempo spots for higher opportunity.
